newsitem.title: UK: Virgin Direct deny Bank of Scotland talks.
newsitem.headline: Virgin Direct deny Bank of Scotland talks.

text.p: Virgin Direct, part of Richard Branson's Virgin Group, on Tuesday denied it was in talks with Bank of Scotland about a joint a venture to enter the banking market .

"It is public knowledge that we have been looking at getting into banking for some time now," said Rowan Gormley, managing director of Virgin Direct. "However, I can confirm that Virgin are not in talks with Bank of Scotland."
Gormley said Virgin Direct had spoken to several potential banking joint venture partners, but no decision had yet been taken on whether to go into banking.
